correctness.rationale: The exact reset-killed voter dual gives conditional stationary mean and an exponential physical-time covariance bound. For independent fair initial signs, Fourier/semigroup convolution computes the variance; local central limit estimates prove the sharp dimensional asymptotics. For dimensions at most four, the largest coefficient divided by standard deviation vanishes, so the Rademacher triangular-array CLT applies. For dimensions at least five, square-summable Green convergence yields a strictly non-Gaussian fourth-cumulant limit. In dimension four, Green-ℓ4 summability and the exact cumulant imply the stated −π^4/8 logarithmic-squared coefficient. A standalone checker passed 231 exact-rational and deterministic normalization checks; finite computations do not replace proof.
